Victorian public library service statistics, 2022-23 to 2024-25

Source: R/data.R
plv_services.Rd

Selected usage measures for each Victorian public library service, taken from the Public Libraries Victoria (PLV) Annual Statistical Survey. Each row is one library service in one financial year. Columns were matched by name across the three yearly sheets, and three services that changed name were recoded to their current names so each has a continuous series.

Usage

plv_services

Format

A tibble with 156 rows (52 services x 3 years) and 11 columns:

service

Library service name. "Victoria (Total)" is the published statewide total and "Vision Australia" is a statewide service for people with print disabilities; neither is a municipal library service.

financial_year

Financial year, a factor with levels "2022-23", "2023-24" and "2024-25".

municipal_population

Residents of the council areas the service covers. NA for Vision Australia. The state total also includes Unincorporated Victoria (about 950 people).

branch_visits

In-person visits to branch libraries. Counts visits, not unique visitors, and excludes mobile, outreach and online use.

mobile_visits

Visits to mobile library vehicles.

outreach_visits

Visits through outreach programs delivered outside library branches.

active_borrowers

Members who borrowed at least once in the year.

physical_loans

Loans of physical items such as books and DVDs.

ebook_loans

Loans of ebooks.

website_visits

Visits to the library service's website. Counts visits, not individual users.

program_attendance

Attendance at library programs and events.

Source

Public Libraries Victoria, 2024-25 PLV Annual Statistical Survey: Final Datasets 2022-23 to 2024-25, https://www.plv.org.au/resources/earlier-reports-and-surveys/. Prepared by data-raw/plv_services.R.

Details

Blank, "-" and "n/a" cells in the source were treated as not reported and stored as NA.

Examples

head(plv_services)
#> # A tibble: 6 × 11
#>   service        financial_year municipal_population branch_visits mobile_visits
#>   <chr>          <fct>                         <dbl>         <dbl>         <dbl>
#> 1 Bayside        2022-23                      102101        366270             0
#> 2 Boroondara     2022-23                      169411        792912             0
#> 3 Brimbank       2022-23                      193146        705558             0
#> 4 Buloke         2022-23                        6110          7137           341
#> 5 Campaspe       2022-23                       38506        110999             0
#> 6 Central Highl… 2022-23                      232011        531640         12437
#> # ℹ 6 more variables: outreach_visits <dbl>, active_borrowers <dbl>,
#> #   physical_loans <dbl>, ebook_loans <dbl>, website_visits <dbl>,
#> #   program_attendance <dbl>

# Statewide branch visits by year
subset(plv_services, service == "Victoria (Total)",
       c(financial_year, branch_visits))
#> # A tibble: 3 × 2
#>   financial_year branch_visits
#>   <fct>                  <dbl>
#> 1 2022-23             20120892
#> 2 2023-24             22896880
#> 3 2024-25             24200961
